body.message:
We had conversation yesterday,👇🏽
Hi 👋🏼 
This is zahra 
I hope you’re doing well.

We would like to inform you that we will not be extending our stay for next month. We are planning to check out on 4th August .

Could you please arrange for someone to inspect the apartment one day before our check-out?

Also, we have two security deposits with you, so we would appreciate it if you could arrange the refund after the inspection.

Thank you very much, and we look forward to your confirmation.🙏🏽
